pages.title: CapsuleBay Overview
pages.summary: An overview of CapsuleBay, a hybrid CI/CD system for modular, image-based capsule deployments with integrated security scanning and secret management.

pages.title: System Architecture
pages.summary: Details the two-layer CI/CD architecture of CapsuleBay, including the GitHub Actions Cloud Validation Layer and the Jenkins Self-Hosted Deployment Layer.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.summary: Instructions for deploying the core infrastructure of CapsuleBay, including setup scripts and service URLs.

pages.title: Managing Capsules
pages.summary: Guidelines for adding new capsules, including folder structure, Dockerfile, and docker-compose.yml requirements.

pages.title: Pipeline Parameters
pages.summary: Explains the parameters used in the CapsuleBay pipeline, including options for service selection and deployment environments.

pages.title: Security Stack
pages.summary: Overview of the integrated security measures in CapsuleBay, including tools and processes for vulnerability scanning and secret management.

pages.title: Discord Notifications
pages.summary: Details on how CapsuleBay sends notifications to Discord at the end of each pipeline run, including message format and content.

pages.title: Repository Structure
pages.summary: Describes the organization of the CapsuleBay repository, including the purpose of each directory and key files.
